Sophie: Heads-up — planning preflight for Ceres private VPC deploy this Wed 2026-04-15 02:00-03:00 UTC. Who's on the deploy? Need smoke, rollback ready, and DB migration hold. /cc @Anna @Mike

deploy-bot: Scheduled window confirmed for 2026-04-15 02:00-03:00 UTC. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ceres-vpc-deploy :calendar:

Anna: I'll own the smoke tests and canary. Plan: canary to 10% for 15m, then full roll. Smoke checklist posted below.

Anna: Smoke checklist:
- API health 200s on /health
- 1k random calls through traffic-replay
- embeddings core latency under 120ms

Anna: Smoke commands:
```
ssh deploy@vpc-ceres
./deploy.sh --smoke
curl -sS https://ceres.internal/health | jq .status
```

Mike: Rollback images ready: `redwood/ceres:20260414-rollback`. DB migration is non-destructive for this release. I can trigger rollback within 5m if failure.

Kevin: I'll monitor logs and trace spikes. Will run the first canary and post a short report. @Sophie do we want post-mortem notes template filled out in case?

Sophie: Yes — use the standard deployment notes template. Link in runbook. Also please annotate the route ids if you see increased 5xxs.

sre-oncall: Monitoring checklist:
- Grafana dashboard: infra/deploys/ceres
- Alert policy in PagerDuty: PD escalation on >5% 5xx rate for 3m
- Tracing: sample rate to 100% for the canary window
I'll be on-call for the window.

Anna: Quick Q — is KV cache warm? Need confirm from infra.

Omar: KV priming done. Cache warmed via replay at t-2h. TTL shorted to 30s for test.

Mike: DB replica lag at 0-2s, backups OK. Snapshot id: snap-20260413-03

Kevin: Preflight CI link: https://ci.redwood.internal/ceres/12345 — green
